director.text: 7 wale cake se

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 7 tukdon wala cake kam barabar tukdon mein kata, toh uska har tukda 9 wale ke tukde se bada hai. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Ek chocolate 8 bachchon mein barabar bati, aur utni hi badi doosri chocolate 2 bachchon mein. Farhan 8 waalon mein hai, Gita 2 waalon mein. Farhan ka tukda Gita ke tukde se zyada hai ya kam?
director.card: Ek chocolate 8 bachchon mein barabar bati, aur utni hi badi doosri chocolate 2 bachchon mein. Farhan 8 waalon mein hai, Gita 2 waalon mein. Farhan ka tukda Gita ke tukde se zyada hai ya kam?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain.

director.text: Farhan ka tukda kam

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 8 mein bati chocolate ka har tukda 1/8 hai, 2 mein bati ka 1/2; 1/8 chhota hai, toh Farhan ka tukda kam. Board par teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: pehli 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.
director.card: Board par teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: pehli 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.

director.text: 1/4, 1/7, 1/10 sahi nahi hai. Har tukde ka neeche wala number dekho: woh batata hai chocolate kitne barabar tukdon mein kati. Phir patle tukde se mote tak lagao. Teen ek jaisi chocolate ke 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7 tukdon ko sabse chhote se sabse bade tak kaise lagaoge?
director.card: Board par teen ek jaisi chocolate hain: pehli 4 barabar tukdon mein kati, doosri 10 mein, teesri 7 mein. Har chocolate ka ek tukda lo, 1/4, 1/10 aur 1/7, aur inhe sabse chhote se sabse bade tak lagao.

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka sahi jawab: ek-dasvaan, ek-saatvaan, ek-chauthaai, kyunki chocolate jitne zyada tukdon mein kate, tukda utna chhota; isliye pehle 1/10, phir 1/7, phir 1/4. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Chalo, aaj ka ek aakhri sawaal, poore paath se. Is circle ke 9 barabar tukde hain, aur 4 tukdon mein rang hai. Rangin tukde poore circle ka kaunsa fraction hain?
Haan, sahi hai, kyunki circle ke saare 9 barabar tukde neeche wala number banate hain, aur rangin 4 upar wala number; bina rang ke 5 neeche wale number mein nahi jaate. Yahan tak saaf hai?
jo aapne dikhaya tha, usse socha

Kuch baatein aasaan thi, kuch mein mehnat lagi. Aaj dekha ki sirf barabar tukdon ka fraction naam hota hai, aur neeche wala number saare tukde ginta hai. Phir group ka fraction aaya: neeche wala number barabar group ginta hai, aur ek group ki ginti jawab hai. Aakhir mein dekha ki ek jaisi cheez jitne zyada barabar tukdon mein kate, har tukda utna chhota hota hai. Aaj ka paath kaisa laga?
haan, samajh aaya
Har paath mein kuch naya hota hai. Aaj tumne Meena aur Sonu ke tukdon ko 1/3 wale tukde se milaya. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
